description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand' for the OrangeHRM system. The class allows enabling or disabling the system check screen via command line options.

classes.name: ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand
classes.description: A console command class for toggling the system check screen in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command description and options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the toggle action based on the 'status' option, updates the configuration, and outputs the current status.
